title: Introduce RAG dev-sprint kits with step checks and telemetry presets
author: Leah Bennett
description: Adds a compact "dev-sprint kit" family of RAG quickstarts aimed at onboarding engineer cohorts quickly with reproducible step checks, lightweight telemetry presets, and smoke CI jobs. Motivation: teams repeatedly ask for a single, opinionated starter that includes an authoring devcontainer, a minimal indexer, structured output lint checks, and a short guided exercise with step assertions so new contributors can finish a working RAG flow in 30–60 minutes. This PR bundles three small quickstarts: 1) sprint-starter-basic: Node/TS minimal RAG with filesystem indexer and stepwise smoke checks; 2) sprint-starter-authored: same as basic but with pre-authored prompt templates and structured output contract examples; 3) sprint-telemetry-lite: telemetry presets, sample dashboards, and e2e probes for local dev. Key changes: new quickstart templates under quickstarts/dev-sprint-kits, authoring devcontainer with seeded sample data, step-check harness (playground assertions) and a GitHub Actions smoke workflow that runs headless index + inference + structured output linter. Also included are concise README guides, a migration note for older quickstarts, and a release note. See commits summary and files changed below. Checklist: [x] add templates and docs [x] add telemetry presets and dashboards [x] add smoke CI job [x] include migration note and release notes [ ] add more language bindings (follow-up). Related: references ENG-1884 design doc and PM-523 onboarding initiative.
